selection_policy: Existing review candidates and current catalog gaps first; bounded NL-fiction and EN-fantasy/SF/thriller/dystopia/fiction source want_to_read searches. Fixed page/lane/Work-ID tie-break. Only single-author, exact ISBN/normal Edition/single-parent Work chains. Bibliographic IDs, all source ISBNs, canonical titles, translated Edition titles and stored aliases excluded against current production in memory. No fuzzy matching. Editorial review excludes omnibus sets, adaptations, comics, reference substitutes and ambiguous volume bindings; known contradictory author identities quarantined. No genre or Collection claims are inferred.
